curated.tagline: Two AI agents debate any topic — OpenRouter routing and rich terminal UI
curated.description: Open-source terminal experience where two AI agents debate a topic using a Venn-diagram prompt system. Routes models through OpenRouter with a rich terminal UI for arguments, rebuttals, and synthesis.
highlights: Dual-agent debate with structured Venn prompts
OpenRouter model routing for cloud models
Rich terminal UI for following the exchange
curated.architecture: CLI → Prompt orchestrator → OpenRouter → Dual agent turns → Terminal renderer
